question: Riverside School's Year 6 has 131 students, but 12 were absent on the day of the trip collection. Each student who was present handed in 5 dollars. The parents' association then tripled the amount collected, so the fund stood at triple what the students had paid. The coach hire and museum tickets cost 1762 dollars, which came out of the fund. Afterwards one parent donated 35 dollars, and another parent also gave 35 dollars. How many dollars are left in the trip fund?

Omar's orchard had 215 apple trees, but 182 diseased trees were cut down. Each remaining tree yielded 5 crates of apples, and each crate weighed 5 kilograms. His neighbour Lena, whose harvest was smaller than Omar's, gave him 31 kilograms of her apples to sell with his. The cider mill paid 9 cents for every kilogram, and Omar recorded the payment in cents although a hundred cents make a dollar. How many cents did the mill pay Omar?

Dev collected 86 dollars in sponsorship for a charity walk that took him five hours, three hundred minutes. His uncle had promised to triple whatever he collected, and he did, so the fund stood at triple the original amount. Afterwards his aunt gave 36 dollars, his teacher gave 36 dollars, a neighbour gave 19 dollars, and his grandmother gave 38 dollars. Dev's sister Sana raised less than Dev. How many dollars did Dev raise in total?

In the morning a pizzeria had 173 dough balls in the fridge; 107 were used for lunch pizzas and 25 had gone stale and were thrown out. In the afternoon the chef divided every remaining dough ball into 3 smaller balls for garlic knots, then mixed 64 fresh small balls and later 73 more, all going into the same tray. In the evening every small ball in the tray was baked and cut into 4 pieces for the tasting menu. How many pieces were there?

In the morning the library's returns trolley held 160 books, and 21 more books were returned before ten o'clock. In the afternoon a dozen volunteers reshelved 37 books from the trolley. In the evening 63 books came back through the drop box, and 3 more were handed in at the desk just before closing. How many books were on the returns trolley at the end of the evening?

Lena had 111 marbles in a jar that weighs 3 kilograms when full. She gave 51 marbles to the school raffle. She then divided the marbles she had left into 2 equal shares, one for herself and one for her brother Max. Her aunt gave Lena 7 more marbles, but she lost 7 marbles in the garden. Lena and Max now have the same number of marbles. How many marbles does Lena have now?

In the morning a fruit stand had 64 peaches and sold 51 of them. In the afternoon the farmer dropped off 4 more peaches, and 1 peach was found rotten and thrown away. In the evening the stallholder packed the remaining peaches equally into 4 bags and took one bag round to her neighbour, who added 26 peaches from her own tree to that bag. How many peaches were in the bag then?

In the morning Pedro unpacked 140 boxes of mangoes, with 2 mangoes in every box, onto his market stall. By noon he had sold 136 mangoes. In the afternoon a farmer brought him 58 more mangoes. In the evening a restaurant bought every mango he had left at 9 pesos each and added a 34-peso tip. Pedro's neighbour Ana took in less from her stall than Pedro did in the evening. How many pesos did Pedro receive from the restaurant?

Yara saved 92 dollars a week from her job for 4 weeks. She received 23 dollars for her birthday, spent 55 dollars on a jacket, earned 57 dollars babysitting, and then paid 163 dollars for a concert ticket. She keeps her account in dollars, though she knows a hundred cents make a dollar. Her friend Sami has less saved than Yara. How many dollars does Yara have saved now?

Farmer Bea has 22 dairy cows and buys 79 more at auction. Each cow gives 7 litres of milk a day, and she collects all the milk for 3 days into one tank. Her barn has 15 stalls. A neighbour then pours 6 litres of his own milk into the tank. Her rival Carl's tank holds less milk than Bea's. How many litres of milk are in Bea's tank?

In the morning a juice bar received 119 kilograms of oranges. In the afternoon two more deliveries brought 78 kilograms and 30 kilograms. In the evening a final crate added 60 kilograms; the bar weighs everything in kilograms, though it knows a thousand grams make a kilogram. Every kilogram of oranges is turned into juice that sells for 3 dollars. How many dollars will the day's oranges bring in?

A pack of 20 stickers was shared equally among 4 children, and Ola kept her share. Her aunt then gave her 16 more stickers, and she used 12 stickers on her homework folder. At the school shop every sticker can be swapped for 4 tokens, and Ola swapped all of hers. The swap took her about a quarter of an hour, fifteen minutes. How many tokens does Ola have?

Jonas picked 23 bags of pears in the morning and 24 bags after lunch, with 3 pears in every bag. He tipped them all into a crate and added 36 loose pears from the ground. At the market he sold 154 pears, then his cousin Ana, whose crate held fewer pears than his, gave him 37 pears she could not sell. Each pear weighs about 200 grams. How many pears are in Jonas's crate now?

In the morning Mira had 82 marbles in her bag, and she won 44 more at recess. In the afternoon she gave half of her marbles to her brother. In the evening at the toy swap she traded every marble she had left for 4 beads each, and then gave 124 of the beads to her cousin. How many beads does Mira have?

A nursery sowed 20 trays of lavender, each tray having 9 rows with 3 seedlings in every row. It sold 271 seedlings in the spring. From every seedling that was left, the gardener took 6 cuttings, and a friend gave her 67 cuttings from his own plants. The greenhouse is 12 metres long. How many cuttings does the gardener have?

In the morning the church donation box held 75 dollars, and a visitor added 36 dollars. In the afternoon a wedding party put in 55 dollars and a passer-by added 32 dollars. In the evening the treasurer took 150 dollars out of the box to pay the electricity bill. How many dollars were left in the donation box?

The knitting club's 82 members each knitted 9 squares for a charity blanket, and half of them stayed late to sew. A local shop gave 51 ready-made squares as well. Every square takes 7 metres of yarn, and the club measures its yarn in metres although a thousand metres make a kilometre. Of all the yarn used, 1973 metres had been donated free; the rest was bought. The club meets on the 3rd Tuesday of every month. How many metres of yarn did the club have to buy?

Sofia's coin jar held 198 coins. She spent 179 coins at the arcade and lost 9 coins on the bus. Her father then gave her 33 coins, and she found 65 coins in an old coat. Her friend Luis has fewer coins in his jar than Sofia. How many coins are in Sofia's jar now?

A club bought 151 balloons for the hall, which is 20 metres long. While inflating them, 37 balloons popped, and 84 were given away to children at the door. The remaining balloons were tied into 6 equal bunches. From the bunch by the stage, 2 balloons floated away. How many balloons were left in the bunch by the stage?

Tom had 32 pairs of socks, with 2 socks in each pair, all loose in one drawer. He put 51 socks in the wash and lost 4 socks behind the machine. His mother then bought him 30 socks, and his grandmother sent 76 more, all of which went into the drawer. The drawer has 3 compartments. How many socks are in Tom's drawer now?

In the first week of training Nina ran 33 minutes a day. In the second week she doubled her daily time and kept that up for all 7 days of the week. Her coach did not count 89 of those second-week minutes because they were warm-up, but he added 17 minutes for a time trial. Her teammate Eli was credited with fewer minutes than Nina for that week. How many minutes was Nina credited with for the second week?

In the morning Liam unloaded 39 boxes for the cake stall; each box held 4 trays, and each tray held 9 mini cupcakes, all of which went onto his counter. He then added 70 mini cupcakes from a spare tin. In the afternoon he cut every mini cupcake on the counter into 3 tasting pieces, and packed the pieces into bags of 3. In the evening his sister brought 30 more bags of the same pieces to add to his stock. How many bags did Liam have at the end of the evening?

Coach Maria's swimming club had 195 members, and 48 more joined in January. Every member paid a 5-dollar entry fee for the spring gala, and a local shop donated 45 dollars on top. The club was founded 20 years ago. The gala cost 284 dollars to run, which came out of the fee money. Coach Diego's club raised less for its own gala than Maria's club. How many dollars did Maria's club have left after paying for the gala?

In the morning a stationery warehouse loaded 46 pallets onto a lorry; each pallet carried 7 boxes, each box held 3 cartons, each carton held 6 packs, and each pack held 9 pens. In the afternoon the lorry reached the shop, where everything was unpacked pen by pen onto the stockroom shelves. In the evening the shopkeeper added 22 pens from a returned order to the same shelves. How many pens were on the stockroom shelves at the end of the evening?

A cinema has 9 screens, each with 7 rows of 45 seats, and it runs 8 shows a day on every screen. On Saturday half of all the seats across all the day's shows were sold. A private booking then added 45 more tickets. Every ticket sold for 5 dollars. The cinema opened 12 years ago. How many dollars did the cinema take in on Saturday?
